tactics:
induction l generalizing l' i with
  | nil => simp at h
  | cons a t ih =>
    cases l' with
    | nil => simp at h
    | cons b t' =>
      cases i with
      | zero => rfl
      | succ n => exact ih t' n (by simp [List.zipWith_cons_cons] at h; omega)

induction l generalizing i l' <;> cases l' <;> cases i <;> simp only [List.zipWith_cons_cons, List.zipWith_nil_left, List.zipWith_nil_right, List.getElem_cons_zero, List.getElem_cons_succ, List.length_nil, List.length_cons] at h ⊢ <;> simp_all
